title: 第18章 回归，灵脉与灵根
content_zh:
【奖励发放：天地奇物·灵脉，天材地宝·先天灵根】

    【本次世界代行者任务完成率：100%，馈赠道种点：5】

    【下一次降临时间：7天】

    -----------------

    魏乐府睁开眼睛，他依旧在自己的家庙里。

    他没来得及去查看所赠送的灵脉和先天灵根是什么东西，最先让他反应过来的是不舒服。

    整个世界给他的感觉就像是濒临死亡一样的难受。

    硬要比喻的话，那他就是一条鱼，而世界是个正在干涸的小水潭。

    和丁守成所在的世界相比，完全不可同日而语。

    之前他没有感觉出来，自然是因为他生活习惯了，可这次这么一来一回后，就能够感受到极为明显的问题。

    “世界，正在死亡。”魏乐府下了结论：“所以灵气复苏是祂的回光返照。”

    “这才导致了灵气复苏显得这么奇葩招笑。”

    “而我们这群世界代行者，则是世界在借着回光返照的最后一点力气在自救。”

    “所以这才会有门槛和测试。”

    魏乐府并不清楚世界死亡后，他们会是如何，但不用想都知道下场肯定不好。

    随后，他的目光落在了天地奇物和天材地宝两件东西上。

    -----------------

    【灵脉】

    【等级：微型】

    【周天流转：自成周天，灵气环流不息】

    【八方来朝：四方灵气闻息而至，如百川归海】

    -----------------

    【先天灵根】

    【效果1：天级以下资质提升至天级】

    【效果2：伴生类灵体具备成长性】

    -----------------

    根据入手后所获得的信息，天地奇物炼化后放置和使用就能够生效。

    等级和效果，会根据灵气复苏程度和炼化的天地奇物类型、效果、数量进行组合、提升等等。
content_en:
[Reward distribution: Wonderful objects of heaven and earth, spiritual veins, treasures of heaven and earth, innate spiritual roots]

    [Completion rate of this world agent mission: 100%, gifted Taoist points: 5]

    [Next arrival time: 7 days]

    ------------------

    Wei Yuefu opened his eyes, he was still in his family temple.

    He didn't have time to check what the gifted spiritual veins and innate spiritual roots were. The first thing that made him react was discomfort.

    The whole world made him feel as uncomfortable as if he was on the verge of death.

    If we want to use metaphors, he is a fish, and the world is a small pool that is drying up.

    Compared with the world where Ding Shoucheng lives, it is completely different.

    He didn't feel it before, naturally because he was used to it, but after doing this again and again this time, he could feel an extremely obvious problem.

    "The world is dying." Wei Yuefu concluded: "So the revival of spiritual energy is his return to light."

    "This is why the spiritual energy recovery seems so weird and laughable."

    "And we, the agents of the world, are the world trying to save itself with the last bit of strength that comes back to the light."

    "That's why there are thresholds and tests."

    Wei Yuefu didn't know what would happen to them after the death of the world, but he knew that the end would definitely be bad without even thinking about it.

    Then, his eyes fell on two things: the wonders of heaven and earth and the treasures of heaven and earth.

    ------------------

    【Spiritual Veins】

    [Level: Micro]

    [circulation of the heavens: self-contained heavens, spiritual energy circulates endlessly]

    [Come from all directions: Spiritual energy from all directions arrives, like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea]

    ------------------

    【Innate Spiritual Root】

    [Effect 1: Qualifications below heaven level are upgraded to heaven level]

    [Effect 2: The accompanying spirit-like body has the ability to grow]

    ------------------

    Based on the information obtained after acquiring it, the wonders of heaven and earth can take effect after being placed and used after being refined.

    The levels and effects will be combined, improved, etc. according to the degree of spiritual energy recovery and the type, effect, and quantity of the refined heaven and earth wonders.
title_en: Chapter 18 Return, spiritual veins and spiritual roots
